summary.text: Use the Manage your MediSave payable form to request monthly instalments.

details.heading: Approval and documents
details.body: Your request is subject to the Board’s approval. You may be required to provide additional information or supporting documents, if necessary.

steps.name: Submit the request
steps.text: Use the Manage your MediSave payable form to request an instalment plan for monthly MediSave contributions.

example_phrasings: How do I request an instalment plan for my MediSave contributions?
How can I pay my MediSave contributions monthly?
I want to request a MediSave instalment plan

sources.page_title: How do I request an instalment plan for my MediSave contributions?

quotes.text: You can request an instalment plan to make your MediSave contributions in monthly instalments via the Manage your MediSave payable form.
Please note that your request is subject to the Board’s approval. You may be required to provide additional information or supporting documents, if necessary.
